summary: Join our Health and Safety Compliance Training Course to foster a safer workplace. Gain crucial knowledge to maintain compliance and safeguard your team.
lede: Workplace health and safety compliance training helps safety, risk and operations professionals turn requirements into practical workplace controls. It is for people responsible for safety, risk or compliance who need to assess hazards and put policies into daily practice. Participants learn to prioritize risks, investigate incidents, prepare emergency responses and use audits and performance measures to improve safety practices and support employee well-being.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals responsible for workplace safety, risk, or compliance. It's designed to equip you with the necessary skills to lead and manage safety initiatives effectively.
audience: Health and Safety Officers or Supervisors
Public Sector Inspectors and Policy Officers
modules: Understanding Workplace Health and Safety Compliance
Implementing and Sustaining a Safety Management System
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of workplace operations and a basic familiarity with safety protocols. Previous experience in safety or compliance roles is beneficial but not required.
